safety_margin_analysis.duration_at_temp: SMA transition is fast (seconds), but thermal diffusion to surrounding tissue depends on pulse duration
safety_margin_analysis.risk_assessment: MARGIN NARROW but workable with thermal isolation (which is M3_REFINED's novel feature)

analysis.verdict: CONDITIONAL_FAIL — without thermal isolation, the activation temperature (42-47°C) is too close to tissue injury thresholds (45-50°C). WITH thermal isolation (M3_REFINED's load-bearing novel feature), the safety margin can be widened. This makes the thermal isolation element MECHANICALLY NECESSARY, not just convenient — which is exactly what ATTACK_1 required to survive.
analysis.implications_for_M3_REFINED: ATTACK_2 STRENGTHENS the case for thermal isolation. The narrow safety margin without isolation is precisely the problem that M3_REFINED's thermal isolation solves. This converts a weakness into a load-bearing novel feature.
